concepts.prompt: Minecraft mod concept art, detailed voxel build rendered with warm realistic shaders, all shapes visibly made of Minecraft full blocks slabs and half-block pieces, restrained late 1800s early 1900s industrial river shipping aesthetic from Nikola Tesla's lifetime. Landscape design presentation of a realistically proportioned SMALL COASTAL/RIVER FREIGHT BOAT, about 7 blocks wide and 17 blocks long, 1 block approximately 1 meter. Main large three-quarter overhead view floating at a timber river wharf; modest aft wheelhouse with a wooden wheel and brass throttle console, low freeboard sturdy dark riveted iron hull with timber deck, broad unobstructed forward working deck. The deck holds two modular cargo units: one open rectangular riveted iron coal bunker with visibly heaped black coal, one horizontal faceted cylindrical iron liquid tank on two saddles with brass sight glass. Both units compact about 3 blocks wide 5 long and 3 high, positioned fore and aft with an accessible side walkway. One Minecraft player for scale. Working vessel, not yacht or gigantic ship, no sails, no fantasy gears, no smokestack forest, no cranes required. Attractive silhouette stepped bow and stern, subtle cream/ochre identification accents and dark weathered iron, readable construction and empty deck space for player customization. Small inset overhead layout sketch in lower right matching main boat. Clear daylight, very crisp material detail. Title 'RIVER FREIGHTER'. This is concept art, not a texture atlas.

Light parchment background and soft daylight shading; title 'COAL BUNKER'. Concept inspiration only not texture atlas.
